DESCRIPTION.1: A Minecraft mapart schematic and map.dat generator, designed to be feasible for both server admins and survival players on servers like
DESCRIPTION.5: , with the goal to add much-requested features and removing the need to download a program.

PRESETS.TITLE: Presets
PRESETS.DELETE-CONFIRM: Would you like to delete this preset:
PRESETS.DELETE-ERROR-DEFAULT: This is a default preset and can't be edited/deleted.
PRESETS.SAVE-PROMPT-ENTER-NAME: Enter a name for your preset:
PRESETS.SHARE-TT: Shares the blocks you have currently selected as a link
PRESETS.SHARE-LINK: Copy this link to share your currently selected blocks
PRESETS.DOWNLOAD-TT: Downloads color palette for use in Paint.NET
PRESETS.DOWNLOAD-WARNING-MAX-COLOURS-2: colors, while the maximum in Paint.NET is 96. Some colors will be unavailable in Paint.NET

ADD-CUSTOM.TITLE: Add Custom
ADD-CUSTOM.NO-EXPORT: Note: Custom blocks will not be exported.

MAP-PREVIEW.TITLE: Map preview
MAP-PREVIEW.BEST-RESOLUTION-TT: A source image with this resolution will work the best
MAP-PREVIEW.ASPECT-RATIO-MISMATCH-TT: Image doesn't match map's aspect ratio

IMAGE-EDITOR.TITLE: Image editor (BETA)
IMAGE-EDITOR.SUBTITLE: IN DEVELOPMENT—make manual edits to your dithered map here
IMAGE-EDITOR.SHORTCUTS: Ctrl+scroll to zoom · Ctrl+drag or middle-click drag to pan · right-click to pick a colour
IMAGE-EDITOR.COPY-FROM-PREVIEW-TT: brings the image in the map preview into the editor as a new layer
IMAGE-EDITOR.COPY-IMAGE-TT: Copy the map as a PNG at map resolution (one pixel per map pixel) to your clipboard
IMAGE-EDITOR.PALETTE-NOTE: (based on current block selection and staircasing setting)
IMAGE-EDITOR.OUTSIDE-PALETTE: pixels use colours the current block selection cannot produce (transparent pixels count when Air is not selected), they're gonna get quantized

MAP-SETTINGS.TITLE: Settings
MAP-SETTINGS.MODE-TT: Select the mode you'd like to operate in
MAP-SETTINGS.VERSION-TT: Select the version closest to what you're running

CROP.TITLE: Crop
CROP.TITLE-TT: Crops your image instead of stretching it out

DOWNSCALING.TITLE: Downscaling
DOWNSCALING.TITLE-TT: How the image is shrunk to map resolution
DOWNSCALING.GAMMA-CORRECT-TT: Average in linear light instead of sRGB values, so fine high-contrast texture keeps its brightness when shrunk. Has no effect on point sampling.

MAP-SETTINGS.GRID-OVERLAY-TT: Overlays a grid that shows 16x16 chunks and 1x1 splits

3D.TITLE: Staircasing
3D.TITLE-TT: Adds three times the colors for 10 times the difficulty. More details in Schematic options.

SCHEMATIC.TITLE: Schematic options
SCHEMATIC.LEGACY-NOTE: PNG-to-NBT only supports Minecraft 1.21.4 and newer, so this uses MapartCraft's original schematic generator!

SHADING-METHOD.TITLE: Shading method
SHADING-METHOD.TITLE-TT: Choose Staircasing Group if you don't know what to do here
SHADING-METHOD.NORTHLINE-TT: Northline: each column steps up and down from a reference (noob) line of blocks along the north edge.
SHADING-METHOD.SOUTHLINE-TT: Southline: each column is lined up from the bottom (south) row instead.
SHADING-METHOD.VALLEY-TT: Valley: like classic but valleys instead of straight lines
SHADING-METHOD.GROUP-TT: Group: like Valley but groups nearby columns
SHADING-METHOD.STEPS-PAIRS-TT: Steps: Pairs: dual row color suppression
SHADING-METHOD.STEPS-CHECKER-TT: Steps: Checker: quad row color supporession
SHADING-METHOD.2-LAYER-TT: 2-Layer: 2 maps for the price of one

LATE-SHADING.TITLE: Late shading
LATE-SHADING.TITLE-TT: For maps that need extra blocks placed while the upper layer of a 2-Layer build is being removed.

SCHEMATIC.CRUBTECH-TT: Build for the CrubTech 2-layer platform: moss and pushable blocks for the shading and support, with the direction, spacing and support set the way the platform needs them. Ticking it also switches to the CrubTech block preset, unless you're using a palette of your own.
SCHEMATIC.LAYER-GAP-TT: How many blocks apart the lower and upper layers are.
SCHEMATIC.LATE-PAIRS-GAP-TT: How far above the upper layer the late pairs go.

SUPPORT.TITLE: Support
SUPPORT.TITLE-TT: Blocks added under the map art for survival building.
SUPPORT.STEPS-TT: Steps: support under every raised block.
SUPPORT.FRAGILE-TT: Fragile: support under blocks that can't stand on their own, like carpets and sand.
SUPPORT.WATER-TT: Water: support around water, or under ice pillars when ice stands in for water.

SCHEMATIC.SUPPORT-BLOCK-TT: The block the support is built from.
SCHEMATIC.PUSHABLE-BLOCK-TT: CrubTech's shading and support blocks that have to stay pushable by pistons and slime. The breakable ones are always moss.

SUPPRESSION-DIRECTION.TITLE: Suppression direction
SUPPRESSION-DIRECTION.TITLE-TT: Like which sides you start and end on

SCHEMATIC.SUPPRESS-ONE-DIRECTION-TT: one side to the other vs center outwards
SCHEMATIC.KEEP-REUSABLE-BLOCKS-TT: Keep blocks that can be reused between steps to provide shading, so there's less placing and mining. Turn off for platforms that clear themselves.
SCHEMATIC.BLOCK-RECYCLING-TT: Allows you to leave blocks that are reused in the next map
SCHEMATIC.CREDIT-1: Schematics for 1.21.4 and newer are generated by EvModder's

MAPDAT-SPECIFIC.UNOBTAINABLE-COLOURS-TT: Enables map.dat colors unobtainiable in schematics
MAPDAT-SPECIFIC.MODERN-NAMING-TT: newer mc versions use n.dat instead of map_n.dat

MAP-SETTINGS.BETTER-COLOUR-TT: How the difference (distance) between colors is calculated
MAP-SETTINGS.BETTER-COLOUR-MORE-TT: Show every colour distance metric, not just HCT and CIE76 D65

DITHERING.TITLE: Dithering
DITHERING.TITLE-TT: Adds seemingly random pixels for the illusion of more colors
DITHERING.MORE-OPTIONS-TT: Show every dither method and every sharpen variant
DITHERING.BOUSTROPHEDON-TT: Alternate the scan direction on every other row; reduces the diagonal streaking error diffusion can produce. No effect on ordered dithers.
DITHERING.STRENGTH-TT: How much of each pixel’s colour error is carried into its neighbours
DITHERING.ADVANCED-STRENGTH-TT: Set the dither strength for red, green and blue separately

PREPROCESSING.TITLE: Image preprocessing
PREPROCESSING.VIBRANCE-TT: Boosts muted colours more than already-vivid ones, and goes easy on skin tones. Negative values do the reverse, calming the most saturated colours first.
PREPROCESSING.WARMTH-TT: Shifts the white balance: positive is warmer (towards amber), negative is cooler (towards blue), without changing brightness.
PREPROCESSING.NOISE-REDUCTION-TT: Smooths grain and speckle while keeping edges: neighbouring pixels are averaged only where they are already similar in colour.

NBT-SPECIFIC.DOWNLOAD-SPLIT-TT: Download the nbt split into 1x1 chunks

MAPDAT-SPECIFIC.DOWNLOAD-TT: Download the map.dat split into 1x1 chunks

PNG-TO-NBT.LATE-SHADING-USED: Needed late shading, so it was built as 2-Layer with {method}.
PNG-TO-NBT.LAYER-GAP-RAISED: Its blocks need a layer gap of at least {gap}, so it was built with that.
PNG-TO-NBT.DIRECTION-CHANGED: Suppressing {from} would lose some of its void or water shading, so it was built {to} instead.
PNG-TO-NBT.CONNECT-FAILED: Couldn't reach PNG-to-NBT on evmodder.net, so no schematic was made. Check your connection and try again.
PNG-TO-NBT.BLOCK-REJECTED: PNG-to-NBT doesn't accept {block} as {colour} in Minecraft {version}. Pick a different block for that colour.

MATERIALS.TITLE: Materials
MATERIALS.SHOW-PER-SPLIT: Only show max mats per split
MATERIALS.SHOW-PER-SPLIT-TT: For material reuse with locked maps
MATERIALS.SORTED-TT: Disable to show materials in a predictable order

VIEW-ONLINE.TITLE: VIEW ONLINE
VIEW-ONLINE.TITLE-TT: View the schematic online without downloading
VIEW-ONLINE.TOO-BIG-FOR-SINGLE: Too big for single schematic; download 1x1 split
